app.name: Bambulab X1C
app.summary: Shows the status and temperatures of a Bambulab X1C 3D printer.
app.opt_print_status_hint: The sensor that shows the current print state (e.g. Printing, Idle).
app.opt_progress_hint: The sensor that shows the print progress in percent (0–100).
app.opt_layer_hint: The sensor that shows the current layer number.
app.opt_time_remaining_hint: The sensor that shows the remaining print time in minutes.
app.opt_nozzle_temp_hint: The sensor for the nozzle temperature in °C.
app.opt_bed_temp_hint: The sensor for the heated bed temperature in °C.
app.opt_chamber_temp_hint: The sensor for the chamber temperature in °C.
app.opt_total_layers_hint: The sensor that shows the total number of layers in the print job.
app.opt_job_name_hint: The sensor that shows the name of the current print job (task name).
